instructions:
1. Set the cable pulley to a mid position and attach a single handle. Stand facing the machine with feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Grasp the handle with your right hand, arm extended toward the machine.
3. Bend your knees slightly, push your hips back, and lean forward a little for balance.
4. Pull the handle to your torso, driving your elbow back and squeezing your shoulder blade toward your spine.
5. Extend your arm back to the start under control.
6. Repeat, then switch to the left arm.
tips:
1. Exhale as you pull, inhale as you return.
2. Keep your hips and shoulders square to resist trunk rotation.
3. Lead with the elbow and squeeze the back, not the arm.
4. Avoid swinging your torso for momentum.
name: Single arm cable row right

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and anchor one end of the band under your left foot.
2. Hold the other end with your right hand and raise that arm overhead, elbow close to your head.
3. Start with your elbow bent and your hand behind your head.
4. Extend your arm straight up, fully straightening the elbow.
5. Lower your hand back behind your head under control.
6. Repeat, then switch to the left arm.
tips:
1. Exhale as you extend, inhale as you lower.
2. Keep your upper arm fixed and close to your head.
3. Brace your core so your lower back does not arch.
4. Control the band on the way down for full range.
name: Single arm overhead extension Resistance band

instructions:
1. Set the cable pulley to a low position and attach a single handle. Stand facing the machine with feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Grasp the handle with your left hand, arm extended down toward the machine.
3. Bend your knees slightly, push your hips back, and lean forward a little for balance.
4. Pull the handle to your torso, driving your elbow back and squeezing your shoulder blade toward your spine.
5. Extend your arm back to the start under control.
6. Repeat, then switch to the right arm.
tips:
1. Exhale as you pull, inhale as you return.
2. Keep your hips and shoulders square to resist trunk rotation.
3. Lead with the elbow and squeeze the back, not the arm.
4. Avoid swinging your torso for momentum.
name: Single arm standing low cable row

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding one dumbbell with both hands under the top plates, palms facing up.
2. Let the dumbbell hang in front of your hips with arms extended.
3. Curl the dumbbell up toward your chest by bending your elbows.
4. Squeeze your biceps at the top.
5. Lower the dumbbell back to the start under control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your upper arms still against your sides.
2. Exhale as you curl, inhale as you lower.
3. Use a controlled tempo instead of swinging the weight.
4. Keep your wrists firm and neutral throughout.
name: Single Dumbbell Biceps Curls

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand in front of your thighs.
2. Keep your back flat and shoulders back.
3. Bend at your hips and knees to lower the kettlebell toward the floor.
4. Push through your heels and extend your hips and knees to stand up.
5. Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower under control. Switch hands. Repeat.
tips:
1. Exhale as you lift and inhale as you lower.
2. Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
3. Hinge at the hips, do not round your lower back.
4. Brace your core to resist twisting toward the loaded side.
name: Single kettlebell deadlift
